title: Jacob flees to Laban in Haran (Bethel vision)
summary: After receiving Isaac's blessing, Jacob (aged 77) flees from Esau to Laban in Haran; at Bethel he dreams of the ladder (Gen 27-28).
description: Jacob left Beersheba for Haran and saw the ladder to heaven at Bethel (Gen 28:10-22). His age (77) is derived from Gen 41:46, 45:6 and 47:9.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1759 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), p. 62 ("1759 B.C. 77 year old Jacob fled to Laban (Chart Two)")
chronologies.note: On p. 65 Jones says Ussher placed Jacob's arrival at Haran about BC 1760 and "had been right". The two figures differ by one year (departure vs. the start of the 7 years of service?).

chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Third Age §111 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
chronologies.note: §111-112. The transcription has a typo here: "Jacob was 77 years old in 2259 AM" (should be 2245).

chronologies.date: 2245 - ... Jacob leaves home at age 77 to get a wife in Padan-Aram. God appears to him at the top of a ladder to heaven (Gen. 27-28).
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 4)," Biblical Chronology 6:6 (June 1994), §13 "Jacob and Esau" (year list)

chronologies.date: 2245 AM Jacob, 77 yrs old, meets Rachel.
